notices.text: If freq_filebox_dir is still ftn/filebox (the old default), your board serves file requests (FREQ) from the same directory that holds per-peer outbound fileboxes, so any file left at its top level can be requested by any system you link with. New installs now use a separate ftn/freq, which this update creates; your setting is not changed. To separate them, move the files you mean to offer into ftn/freq and set freq_filebox_dir to ftn/freq under Paths on the Configuration page.
